title: Fix monthly progression rules: Plank +15 seconds/month; Squash constant; others unchanged

requirements.text: Update backend monthly compounding so the habit named "Plank" (unitType = "time") increases by exactly +15 seconds per month (e.g., if January is 1:00 then February is 1:15), while the habit named "Squash" (unitType = "time") remains constant across all future months (e.g., 45:00 every month). All other habits must keep the existing compounding behavior unchanged.

quotes: Plank should go up by 15 seconds each month
Also squash just remains 45 mins every month
yes apply but leave all other habits as they are as they are correct

acceptanceCriteria: When updating volume for habit name "Plank" with unitType="time", backend compounds future months by +15 seconds each month (not +15 minutes).
When updating volume for habit name "Squash" with unitType="time", backend sets all future months to exactly the same per-completion value as the edited month (no increases).
Backend compounding for all other habits remains identical to current behavior (e.g., time habits other than Plank/Squash continue the existing increment; reps continue the existing increment).

Backend compounding uses seconds-accurate storage for Plank: the compounded entry preserves seconds (via timeString) and stores minutes consistent with the compounded seconds (floor(totalSeconds/60)).
Regression check: calling updateHabitVolume for non-time habits still works and returns the same compounded results as before.

requirements.text: Fix backend unitType initialization during volume updates so that time-based edits do not accidentally compound using the default "reps" rules. If a habit has no existing volumeTracking and the incoming volume entry includes a timeString (time input), initialize volumeTracking.unitType to "time" (otherwise keep existing behavior).

quotes: Also squash just remains 45 mins every month

acceptanceCriteria: If habit.volumeTracking is null and updateHabitVolume is called with entry.timeString set, the newly created volumeTracking.unitType is "time".
After this change, Squash does not increase across months due to being compounded as reps when first setting its time volume.

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend volume display continues to show seconds-accurate values for Plank across months (e.g., 1:15, 1:30, …) based on values returned from the backend, and that Squash displays the same time (e.g., 45:00) for each month. Do not change the behavior of other habits.

quotes: Also squash just remains 45 mins every month
leave all other habits as they are as they are correct

acceptanceCriteria: After saving January volume for Plank as 1:00 (time), switching month tabs shows Feb=1:15, Mar=1:30, etc., matching backend-returned values.
After saving Squash volume as 45:00 (time), switching month tabs shows 45:00 for all months.
No UI regressions for editing volumes of other habits; their display and progression remain unchanged.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not introduce new backend services or external databases.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new habits, new unit types, or a configurable progression-rule editor UI.
Changing the app theme or layout beyond what is required to reflect the corrected progression values.
Migrating or rewriting persisted data beyond the runtime compounding logic changes.
